versions.content: When an error is detected during read job processing, the Eep module shall abort the job, shall set the EEPROM state to MEMIF_IDLE and shall set the job result to MEMIF_JOB_FAILED . If configured, the Eep module shall call the notification defined in the configuration parameter EepJobErrorNotification .
